description: Engagement snapshot of a public Instagram account from Instagram's web profile JSON: followers, total posts, and the 12 newest posts with likes, comments, video views and per-post engagement rate ((likes+comments)/followers), plus averages, median likes, best post and posting frequency over those 12. Comment text is not served anonymously, only counts. Hidden like counts give null. Throttling gives 503 (not charged); unknown users 404. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
